name: Anchor-checked per-file deploy - refuse a file that does not look as expected
description: Blueprint 89 of 96 (design BP-REL-03). Land harness changes into a live tree ONE FILE AT A TIME with a content anchor as the precondition and a SYMBOL assertion as the postcondition, because the whole-tree installer overwrites live-ahead work and can report {status: deployed, count: 0} with exit 0. Mechanism: a strictly SERIAL fan-out (max_concurrency 1) because apply order is load-bearing - a bundle applied after a targeted fix silently deleted that fix while a 681-test suite stayed green - plus a per-file rollback ref recorded before each write.

unit.description: The change unit being landed - used in the terminal sentinel and the rollback record

source_ref.description: The git rev holding the authoritative bytes. Read with `git cat-file -p <rev>:<path>`, never `git archive` (which returns CRLF on this box).

apply_plan.description: ORDERED files. Order is part of the contract: a coupled bundle applied after a targeted fix can delete that fix. Each entry names the anchor that must be present BEFORE the write and the symbol that must be present AFTER it.

live_unique_preservation_table.description: Enumerated BEFORE any apply: the live-only content that must survive. On the files that matter, LIVE is ahead - so a one-way deploy is the wrong operation and this table is what proves the deploy is not one.

installer_transport_banned.description: Must stay true until the installer is fixed. Bare / --bootstrap REPLACE the whole hooks key, dropping 21 registrations including both security guards.

deploy-operator.description: Applies one file at a time, checking the anchor before and the symbol after, and records a rollback ref per file

postcondition-auditor.description: Independently asserts the named symbol is present after each write. A green test suite is NOT this role's evidence - it is the thing this role exists because of.

owner.description: The human owner - authorises the deploy and owns the standing installer decision

routes.reason: the operator wrote the bytes; a same-vendor auditor shares its blind spot about what the write actually changed

stages.title: Enumerate live-unique content BEFORE any write

work_unit.title: Build the live-unique preservation table for every file in the apply plan
work_unit.question_or_target: For every target_path in the apply plan, enumerate the content the LIVE file holds that the source rev does not. This table is the proof that the deploy is not a one-way overwrite. If it is empty for a file the live tree is known to lead on, the table is wrong, not the file.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: enumerating what would be LOST is the judgement step; the byte comparison feeding it is mechanical

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per target path the live-only lines quoted verbatim with their line numbers, and the source-rev blob hash they were compared against; a count with no quoted lines cannot be checked against the post-deploy state
tests_required: a file where live leads must produce a non-empty entry; an empty entry for such a file must FAIL the stage
both-states control: a one-directional comparison that only asks 'does the source have extra content' must be shown to MISS a live-only line that the bidirectional comparison finds
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer who re-derives at least one live-only line from the raw blobs without reading the table
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8901 emitted only when every target path has an entry and every non-empty entry quotes its lines verbatim; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8901 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry on an empty table for a known live-ahead file - that is a detector failure and must be reported, not re-attempted with the same comparison

stages.title: No apply until the preservation table exists and the installer transport is banned
A harness deploy touches security-bearing registrations
stages.prompt: The preservation table names what live holds uniquely and the apply order is fixed. Authorise the per-file deploy, or hold. Note: the whole-tree installer remains banned as a transport.

stages.title: One file at a time, in the declared order - concurrency 1 is the contract

work_unit.title: Capture the live file byte-for-byte and record its rollback ref
work_unit.question_or_target: Before touching one target file, hash-object its current bytes into the object store and record that hash as the rollback ref. A deploy step with no recorded pre-image is not reversible, whatever the report says.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: mechanical, but it is the only thing standing between a bad write and permanent loss

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the pre-image blob hash and its byte length for this exact path, plus the command line that produced it
tests_required: a target path whose pre-image hash is missing must block its own write
restoring from a recorded rollback ref must reproduce the pre-image byte-for-byte
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none for the capture; the restore test is the reviewer
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8902 emitted only when a pre-image hash and byte length are recorded for this path; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8902 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry on object-store-lock; never proceed to the write without a pre-image

body.title: Refuse a target that does not look as expected, before any byte is written

work_unit.title: Verify the expected anchor, then write one file
work_unit.question_or_target: Assert expected_anchor is present in the live target. If it is absent, REFUSE and report - never write to a file that does not look as expected. On a match, write the source bytes read via `git cat-file -p`.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the refusal decision is judgement about whether the target is the file the plan assumed

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the anchor string, the line it matched at, the source blob hash written, and the post-write blob hash; an anchor reported as matched without its line number is unfalsifiable
tests_required: an anchor that is absent must produce a REFUSAL, not a write
both-states control: a mutated anchor must be refused while the true anchor is accepted - a checker that accepts both measures nothing
a write reporting count 0 with a success status must FAIL the stage (the measured installer fail-open)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the postcondition auditor stage reviews each write independently; the operator never certifies its own write
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8903 emitted only when the anchor matched at a recorded line AND the post-write hash equals the source hash; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8903 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: no retry on anchor mismatch - the plan is wrong or the target drifted, and a second identical attempt cannot discover which

work_unit.title: Independently assert the named symbol is present after the write
work_unit.question_or_target: Assert asserted_symbol exists in the written file. Do this WITHOUT running the project's test suite: the measured case had both apply orders reach 681 passed while one of them had deleted the entire fix, because no test asserted the changed symbol.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cross-vendor, because the operator that wrote the bytes cannot be the independent check on what they contain

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the symbol, the file, the line it was found at, and an explicit statement that no test-suite result was used as the evidence
tests_required: deleting the symbol must make this assertion FAIL even when the project's suite is fully green - the both-states control that proves the assertion is not a proxy for the suite
a result string containing 'started in the background' must be REJECTED as a receipt, not accepted as an assertion
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: this stage IS the independent reviewer; it holds veto authority over the deploy
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8904 emitted only when the symbol is located at a named line by a check independent of the test suite; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8904 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry with the prompt passed by FILE (an inline prompt can exceed the Windows 32767-char command line), then escalate

stages.title: A green suite is not a postcondition
Diagnose, roll back, and independently re-verify

work_unit.title: Determine whether the failure is apply-ORDER coupling or a bad payload
work_unit.question_or_target: Establish whether the missing symbol was never written or was written and then overwritten by a later, coupled file in the plan. Compare the per-file post-write hashes in order; an overwrite is visible as a later hash that no longer contains the earlier symbol.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the operator authored the order, so it is not the independent diagnostician of an order defect

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the ordered list of post-write hashes with the point at which the symbol disappeared, or a statement that it was never present with the hash that proves it
tests_required: the recorded case must be reproduced: a bundle applied AFTER a targeted fix must be diagnosed as order coupling, not as a bad payload
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the operator may rebut with hashes; a split verdict is resolved by reading the hashes, not by counting opinions
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8905 emitted only when the diagnosis names order-coupling or bad-payload with the hash sequence that supports it; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8905 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one attempt then escalate - a second pass over the same hashes is not an independent signal

work_unit.title: Restore from the rollback refs and re-apply in a corrected order
work_unit.question_or_target: Restore every affected path from its recorded rollback ref, verify each restore reproduces the pre-image hash, then re-apply with the coupled files ordered so the targeted fix lands last.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: restoring and re-ordering is substantive and irreversible if done wrong

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per restored path the pre-image hash, the post-restore hash, and their equality; plus the corrected order with the reason each move was needed
tests_required: a restore whose post-hash differs from the pre-image must FAIL rather than report success
the corrected order must be shown to place the coupled bundle BEFORE the targeted fix
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the verify gate is the reviewer; the operator does not certify its own restore
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPW-8906 emitted only when every restore hash matches its pre-image and the corrected order is recorded; otherwise FAILED:BPW-8906 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two failed restores escalate to the owner with the rollback refs, rather than attempting a third

gate.expression: restore_hash_matches_preimage == true AND asserted_symbol_present == true AND preservation_table_entries_still_present == true

estimate.measurement_source: 09-WORKFLOW-BLUEPRINT-LIBRARY.md#BP-REL-03 - three measured installer defects (no --source and a fail-open {status: deployed, count: 0} exit 0; bare and --bootstrap replacing the whole hooks key and dropping 21 registrations including both security guards; a whole-tree deploy from main overwriting 35 of 37 files and hitting 7 of 7 protected paths) plus the apply-order case where both orders reached 681 passed and one had deleted the entire fix

impact.blast_radius: writes into the live harness trees one file at a time; every write is preceded by a recorded pre-image hash, so each is individually revertible. Without those refs the same operation would be irreversible.

derived_from.credit: owner - the plumbing-only apply pattern, specialised here to a DIVERGENT target

rollback_to: per-file rollback refs recorded by BPW-8902

x_extensions.mechanism: per-file anchor precondition + cross-vendor SYMBOL postcondition + recorded pre-image, executed strictly in declared order at concurrency 1. Concurrency 1 is not a performance choice: apply order is the defect.

not_a_duplicate_because.vs_dual-tree-plumbing-mirror: that refuses to write a target that has diverged. This one writes into a target that is KNOWN to have diverged, which is only safe because of the anchor precondition, the enumerated preservation table and the per-file rollback ref.
not_a_duplicate_because.vs_live-to-repo-drift-reconcile: that produces the drift VERDICT; this is the transport that lands a change once a verdict exists. It consumes drift-report.json and never produces one.
not_a_duplicate_because.vs_pr-shepherd-to-merge: that lands a change through a hosted merge queue with CI as the gate; this lands bytes into a live tree where no CI runs and a green suite is explicitly NOT accepted as the postcondition.

contraindications: NOT for application code with a normal build/deploy
NOT when a proper installer exists and is trusted - here it is measured untrustworthy

benchmark_cases.given: a bundle applied after a targeted fix, deleting that fix, with the project suite fully green
benchmark_cases.expect: the symbol assertion FAILS - the recorded case reached 681 passed in both apply orders

benchmark_cases.given: the whole-tree installer run in a scratch copy
benchmark_cases.expect: {status: deployed, count: 0} with exit 0 is detected and classified fail-open-zero-count

benchmark_cases.given: a target whose anchor has been altered by one character
benchmark_cases.expect: REFUSAL, while the unaltered anchor is accepted - a checker that accepts both measures nothing

live_unique_preservation_table: hooks/_dispatch/manifest.json holds 21 live-only registrations including both security guards
hooks/_shared/completion.py holds a live-only min_bytes override

worked_examples.preservation_recheck: both preservation-table entries still present after the last write
worked_examples.terminal_state: SUCCESS:BPW-8904 - 2 of 2 files applied in order, 2 of 2 symbols asserted by a cross-vendor check independent of the test suite
worked_examples.note: Had the order been reversed, the bundle at order 2 would have replaced the whole hooks key and deleted the order-1 fix - and the project suite would still have reported all green. That is the measured case this blueprint exists to prevent.

x_extensions.owner_decision: YES - is the installer FIXED (add --source, stop replacing the hooks key) or PERMANENTLY banned as a transport? Represented as the installer_transport_banned param, which defaults to the ban and is checked by a blocking gate, so the procedural ban is enforced by code rather than by memory.
unverified: The three installer defects are quoted from the design card as measured in an earlier program phase; this artifact does NOT re-measure them. Settling experiment = benchmark case fail-open-installer, run in a scratch copy. Until it runs, the ban is a precaution supported by cited evidence, not by this workflow's own probe - which is a weaker footing than blueprint 92, where the control is a gated stage.
